notes: The C.I.P. sheet has no legend for its symbols. What each one measures was read from the sheet's own drawing (dimension lines and callouts) and checked against the values: the cone angle against P2, H1, L1 and L2; E, R, e and f against the drawing's scale (1.19:1).

C.I.P. values not mapped to a field: f = 0.25 and an angle of 45° (the case base edge chamfer, read from the drawing); r1 min = 4.00 and r2 = 3.00 (shoulder radii); S = 47.63 (read from the drawing as the distance from the head face to the apex of the shoulder cone); L3+G 1) = 46.70; M = 25.00; the pressure and energy lines. L4, L5 and R3 are printed without a value.

C.I.P. footnote 1) 'Check for safety reasons' is attached to L1, L2, L3, P2, H2, G1 and L3+G; footnote * marks basic dimensions. C.I.P. values are cartridge maxima (CARTRIDGE MAXI); the CHAMBER MINI column is not modelled.

SAAMI gives inches with millimetres in parentheses; the millimetre figure is recorded. Its tolerances are as printed, including the drawing's general note 'BODY DIA. -.008 (0.20) UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED'. SAAMI dimensions not mapped to a field: three axial rim and groove dimensions (1.45 -0.25, 1.07 -0.25, 1.19 +0.25), a 9.20 diameter at 31.80 (headspace datum), a 10.165 diameter at 23.07, a 40° +10° angle at the head, and fillet radii.

Alternatives pair a SAAMI callout with a C.I.P. dimension by position on the drawing, which the SAAMI drawing does not state in words. The drawing is a 612 x 792 pixel raster, so the pairings were checked for geometric consistency rather than by reading labels alone.
